title: Account of a Tic Tac-type craft over Pennsylvania in 1967
summary: Steven Greer tells of Account of a Tic Tac-type craft over Pennsylvania in 1967, about 1967 at Pennsylvania, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: In the book we're going to give you, there's a a very good account of it from 1967 over Pennsylvania,

tellings.difference: Names the book as Disclosure: An Illustrated History, and does not mention the Tic Tac shape.
tellings.link_reason: Both are the 1967 Pennsylvania account in the book Greer is giving away.

plain: Steven Greer is a researcher who leads the Disclosure Project, a group pushing governments to reveal what they know about UFOs. He says one of his books has a very good account of a sighting over Pennsylvania in 1967 of a craft like the Tic Tac, a white oval object shaped like the mint that later became famous. In one telling he names the book as Disclosure: An Illustrated History and does not mention the shape. If true, it would mean such objects were seen decades before they became famous.
